sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO is a merge of accelerators, VAE, and CLIP designed for fast image editing and text-to-image generation using the Qwen Image Edit architecture. Built and maintained by Phr00t, this model runs in ComfyUI and uses FP8 precision to reduce memory requirements while maintaining quality. The core design supports both NSFW and SFW workflows out of the box through ...

sources.snippet: FP8 precision. Both NSFW and SFW models are available! v4 and older combine both NSFW and SFW uses in one model, but performance is subpar. v5+ separates out a NSFW and SFW version, so please pick which model for your use case. Having problems with scaling, cropping or zooming? Scaling images in the TextEncoderQwenEditPlus node is the problem.
